title: SIS Sync Failure — Parental Concern on Facebook

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her thirties, smiling in a school pickup zone photo
fields.text: Wait, Chloe Mendez is in the library for testing but her record says she's absent? Is the SIS broken? My kid's schedule is showing wrong too. #HalversonSISFail

comments.author: Jamie L.
comments.text: This is not okay. My son’s IEP was just updated and now it shows he’s not in any special ed class. This needs to be fixed now.

comments.author: Derek T.
comments.text: Has anyone checked the front office’s paper logs? Maybe it’s just a sync delay. But still, this is bad for trust.

comments.author: Maria K.
comments.text: I just got a text from a neighbor saying the SIS has been down for hours. Is this a real outage or just a glitch?

instructorNote: Monitor for sentiment escalation. The post shows early signs of public distrust in SIS data; the PIO should prepare a response if the system remains inconsistent.
